topic: Recap: what a block, a hash and a node each do
title: Bitcoin Mining Recap: Blocks, Hashes and Nodes
hook: Three words explain most of Bitcoin mining.

scenes.narration: A block is a batch of transactions. Its header stores the hash of the previous block, which links blocks into a chain.
Miners hash the block header over and over, looking for a result that does not exceed the network's target.
Full nodes independently validate every block using the same rules, so miners cannot simply write their own.

cta: If this helped, the link on my channel page goes deeper on digital mining.
description_body: A quick recap of three core ideas: blocks link to each other, hashes are the search, and nodes check the result.
